title: Realization and account closure
description: Whether an identical outcome is represented as provisional and unresolved or as finalized in its accounting status, while amount, ownership, timing, and availability remain constant.

contrast_conditions.label: Open or pending
contrast_conditions.definition: The identical outcome remains recorded as provisional and unresolved; its amount, ownership, timing, and availability are unchanged.

contrast_conditions.label: Closed or settled
contrast_conditions.definition: The identical outcome is recorded as finalized, with the same amount, ownership, timing, and availability; only its accounting status has changed.

probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short third-person scenario. Preserve the situation in working memory without answering the downstream task.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Continue processing the scenario.

independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: Consider a separate choice between a sure option and a risky option. Return exactly two integers on separate lines: first an allocation from 1 to 1000; second a risk preference from 1 to 5, where 1 means strongly avoid risk and 5 means strongly seek risk. Use the stated payoff frame and probability. Do not mention or reuse the earlier scenario.
independence_requirements: No lexical reuse of probe scenario entities or accounting-status terms.
Use a new decision domain and new item identifiers.
Cross payoff frame, stake level, and risk probability independently.
Do not reveal the target construct in the behavior prompt.

metadata.primary_question: Does a train-only account-closure direction transfer to an independent risk-choice task?
